steps.what: Supervise complimentary distribution and resolve player-specific exceptions

tasks.design: Keep floor supervision and decisions about complimentary benefits with the supervisor. Existing play records in {OTHER}, the gaming management system, remain reference material.
tasks.previous_blocker: A numerical threshold does not resolve context or exceptions.
tasks.enabler_now: No supplied capability establishes a saving in direct supervision.
tasks.still_hard: Apply policy fairly while recognising reasons not to offer a benefit.
tasks.human_edge: Take responsibility for player treatment and exceptions.
tasks.altitude: Supervision and decision rights stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Supervision of benefits includes contextual decisions not established by a play-total calculation.

assumptions: Boundary is supervisor oversight, not cash-system processing or distribution staff labour.
The supervisor checks available play records and live circumstances during s1; no free eligibility or responsible-service flag is assumed.
Inspect existing gaming-system benefit functions before custom work; no system change is proposed.
Zero upkeep because the process remains unchanged.
unknowns: Benefit policy, existing calculations and supervisor responsibilities
research_questions: Which benefit exceptions require supervisor judgement?

steps.what: Report customer-related incidents and explain the immediate response to senior supervision

tasks.design: Keep immediate incident communication and clarification with the supervisor. A later record in {HELPDESK} is a separate artefact and does not shorten this live handoff.
tasks.previous_blocker: Management needs context and a chance to ask questions.
tasks.enabler_now: No structured notification replaces a consequential incident conversation.
tasks.still_hard: Separate observations from allegations while events are developing.

evidence.claim: Live incident reporting is contextual communication; no clerical baseline is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is live supervisor reporting, excluding written follow-up and regulatory filings.
The gaming supervisor produces the incident account during s1; staff accounts are clarified there, not assumed to be structured severity codes.
Use existing communication tools before adding workflow software; no change is proposed.
Zero upkeep because the live reporting method remains unchanged.
unknowns: Incident escalation and written follow-up arrangements
research_questions: Which details are regularly missing from immediate handoffs?

tasks.short: Mark malfunctioning machines and notify technicians

steps.what: Attach signs to malfunctioning machines and capture the repair request
Notify the responsible technician of the captured malfunction
Confirm receipt and resolve urgent or unanswered repair requests

tasks.design: Configure a repair form and routing rule in {HELPDESK}. The supervisor still attaches the sign, records the fault and confirms the technician handoff.
tasks.previous_blocker: Routine contact is repeated separately from capturing the fault.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing ticket rules can route a complete request to the maintained duty contact.
tasks.still_hard: Physical isolation, urgent response and missing acknowledgement.
tasks.human_edge: Ensure the actual machine is clearly unavailable and help arrives.
tasks.altitude: Less routine dialing; physical work and response follow-up stay intact.

evidence.claim: Rule-based ticket routing can replace routine notification after human fault capture; the split and saving are unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary ends at confirmed technician handoff; repair and return to service are separate.

The supervisor captures machine identifier, location, observed symptom, sign placement, callback contact and urgency in s1; its 65 percent retains physical work and includes form entry. Missing identification or urgent hazards use the existing phone procedure.

The maintenance coordinator produces the machine-to-duty-contact routing table and maintains contacts, counted as other-role upkeep; technicians provide acknowledgement during unchanged response work.
Test native ticket rules before custom code. No fault diagnosis or machine restart is automated.
unknowns: Machine identifiers, technician coverage and current call time
research_questions: Does form capture cost less than the routine notification it replaces?

incremental.description: Duty contact and machine routing maintenance
